extra padding.reason: RFC 9651 Sections 4.2.5, 4.2.7 and 4.2.8: full date range and string concatenation are retained; missing padding is recovered; excess base64 padding rejects.

non-zero pad bits.reason: RFC 4648 Section 3.5 (https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc4648.html#section-3.5): canonical base64 requires zero unused pad bits. The shared contract rejects nonzero pad bits, including after padding synthesis; RFC 8941 Section 4.2.7 (https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8941.html#section-4.2.7) fails parsing on decoding failure.
